$comment: R1 (RESTRUCTURE.md §1.3, §8 R1): a product owns its budget, repo, data, roadmap and policy overrides; departments work on many products. Every job, run, routine, request, ledger row and event carries product_id and department_id. Figures marked in `proposals` are proposals awaiting the owner (RESTRUCTURE.md §9.2 item 3); the rest are owner decisions with their source in `decided`. A product's `policy` may only make an action stricter than config/autonomy.json (auto < owner < forbidden): a looser override stops the engine.
name: ReplyDesk

repoSource.$comment: R2: the engine fetches ONLY this ref of the owner's clone (REPLYDESK_REPO) into data/products/replydesk/repo.git as main: no outreach/* branch (prospects' personal data, REPLYDESK.md) and no tag. The clone is only read.

runChecksNote: R2: these run inside Docker with --network none, the worktree read-only (owner, R0.3; lib/checks.mjs); lint (ruff) is added once its R2 issue is merged by the owner and the check image rebuilt.

checkImage.$comment: R2: the image the checks run in (lib/checks.mjs), built on the owner's command (npm run check-image -- replydesk) from requirements.txt at main; Python 3.12 as ReplyDesk's CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml). requirements.txt has version ranges and no lockfile, so the build records pip freeze next to the image.
